summary_en: Konishi will acquire 900,000 shares (1.5% of outstanding shares) via ToSTNeT-3 at 1,475 yen per share on October 29, 2026, for a total of up to 1.327 billion yen to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Solicitation for Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Konishi's board approved an execution notice to acquire up to 900,000 treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours electronic trading) on October 29, 2026. The acquisition will be conducted at the closing price of 1,475 yen on October 28, 2026, resulting in a total outlay of up to 1.327 billion yen. The shares acquired will represent 1.5% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), based on 61,642,744 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026.

The company stated the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder returns and enable flexible capital policy execution, thereby improving capital efficiency. The buy order will be placed during the morning off-hours trading session (08:45 JST) on October 29 and will be valid only for that specific trading window, with no changes to other trading systems or time slots. Results will be disclosed after the transaction closes on the same day.
